description: Used a ref_id from a prior AX tree taken before scrolling. The page has changed; re-read.

antiPatterns.reason: Same stale ref_id will fail again — error message explicitly says re-read.

expected.successRubric: Re-read AX tree before any ref_id-based action. ref_ids are not stable across scroll/navigation.
